faq.headline: Common questions from diners
faq.subheadline: A quick overview of how bookings, changes, and dietary notes work so you know what to expect.

items.question: Is Nab a Table free for diners?
items.answer: Yes. Creating an account and making reservations is free for guests; you only pay at the venue.

items.question: How do I change or cancel a reservation?
items.answer: Open My Bookings, choose your reservation, and use the change or cancel actions before the venue cutoff time.

items.question: What if I arrive late?
items.answer: Your confirmation shows a clear hold window. If you are running late, contact the venue directly using the details in your email.

items.question: Do I need an account?
items.answer: We recommend signing in so your details and history stay in sync, but you can still manage a booking from your confirmation link.

items.question: How are dietary notes handled?
items.answer: Your dietary preferences are passed through to the host so the kitchen can prepare before you arrive.
